perimeter: Periodic cubic interpolation of original control points, then equal arclength sampling; actual mesh corners rounded
eye_attachment: Ray intersection with actual exported cranial LOD; eye centre 1.7 mm outward from skull surface along the orbital normal
roof_uv: Least-squares conformal parameterization of actual roof, side and nasal cavity triangles; no roof/side UV cut
scope: Documentary parameters, not a standalone generator or native species genome.
